facts.text: Tim mentioned that his favorite song to play on the piano is a theme from the movie 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone'.

evidence.quote: I love playing different songs on the piano, but my favorite one to jam to is a theme from a movie I really enjoy.
"Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone" is special to me.

facts.text: Tim described watching 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone' with his family as a magical and memorable experience.

evidence.quote: Watching it with my family was amazing. It was so magical!
Watching that movie with my family was awesome, we'd all get comfy with snacks and a blanket and be totally absorbed. Such a special memory!

facts.text: John expressed that he also loves the first 'Harry Potter' movie and has the entire collection.

evidence.quote: I love that first movie too, I even have the whole collection!
